bad_guidance.why: Selected as the carrier for the only CRITICAL concept (table.tabular_figures) on a task about completing data entry without a mouse. The screen already applies the type roles and tabular figures it prescribes; it spent 1 of 3 bundle slots and delivered nothing actionable.

table.inline_edit (grid cell editing / F4 lookup pickers) is absent from the bundle. comp-data-entry-grid was the top candidate (0.606) and carries the F4-picker line verbatim, but was omitted as 'no positive task evidence for a core record'.

guidance_ignored.why: Not a typographic task; the screen already has the roles and tabular figures. Acting on it would have been an unjustified change at a moderate budget on an existing UI.

misses.what: platform_evidence read the word 'mouse' as a positive pointer-input signal, though the sentence negates it ('without touching the mouse'); input resolved to ['keyboard','pointer'] and later drove the concept interaction.hover_independence with reason 'pointer stated'. intent.problem_domain stayed empty on a sentence that names the input device.
table.inline_edit, interaction.focus_restore and interaction.menu_semantics were never demanded for an ERP data-entry grid in audit/refactor mode — the three concepts the task is actually about.

comp-data-entry-grid (top candidate, 0.606, body specifies F2 edit / type-to-edit / F4 lookup pickers / undo / Enter-adds-row) was pruned by the core-record evidence gate, together with comp-data-table, layout-table-first and metadata-rich. The bundle shipped with concern 'component' uncovered while a compatible component record sat at the top of the candidate list.
